evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story expresses the same requirement or is a superset/subset with identical actor and goal.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates the invite-by-URL requirement; similar items (e.g., invite limit) differ in purpose.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: No other story states the same mechanism for starting a round; distinct requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Although PP-031 asks the same view for estimators, the actor differs (moderator vs estimator), so not duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: This story defines selection for estimation; while PP-013 overlaps, PP-005 is the broader/original and not a duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story expresses the same requirement; import/copy alternatives differ in method and are separate stories.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Unique requirement; no other story duplicates editing an item.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Unique deletion requirement; no other story expresses the same action for items.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-033 which requires showing all estimates only after everyone has voted; the timing semantics differ, so not duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: No other story asks for accepting the average as the agreed estimate; distinct from manual entry or autofill rules.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Specific automatic-fill behavior is not duplicated elsewhere (distinct from accepting average or manual entry).

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry of agreed estimate differs from auto-accept/auto-fill behaviors; no duplicate exists.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Substantially contained by PP-005 ('select an item to be estimated or re-estimated') with the same actor and context; no meaningful difference.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Although related to PP-015 (copy/paste), the mechanism differs (import), which is a meaningful distinction rather than duplication.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste is a different method from importing (PP-014); not a duplicate under the uniqueness rule.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games differs from viewing a transcript (PP-017) or scrolling prior rounds (PP-039); actor intent and context differ.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Distinct requirement to view a transcript; export stories (PP-018/PP-019) are related but different actions.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export-to-HTML is a distinct format-specific requirement and not a duplicate of viewing or exporting to CSV (PP-019).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Export-to-CSV is distinct from HTML export and from simply viewing a transcript.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deleting a specific game differs from deleting an account and associated games (PP-024); context differs sufficiently.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is unique and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is distinct from account creation or deletion; no duplicate exists.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account modification is not duplicated by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Deleting an account (and associated games) is distinct from deleting an individual game (PP-020).

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone presentation is a distinct UI/UX requirement; no duplicate found.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder via email is unique and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Specific choice of card scales is a unique configuration requirement; no duplicate exists.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: A numerical invitation limit is distinct from the basic invitation mechanism (PP-002); not duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining via the URL page is not duplicated by any other story (invite and join are complementary but different).

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Participant view of the current item is distinct and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Matches PP-004 thematically but actor differs (estimator vs moderator), so not a duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Presence/indicator of a given estimate differs from seeing the actual estimates (PP-036); not duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Distinct timing semantics compared to PP-009 (show immediately even if not all have voted); not duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Defines the change-window behavior; PP-041 repeats the same condition and actor and is therefore a duplicate of this story.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Prior-estimates-per-estimator is a unique requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Viewing who gave which values in the current round differs from merely seeing that an estimate was given (PP-032); not duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer start capability is distinct; no duplicate found.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Automatic reset behavior is different from manual timer start (PP-037); not a duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Participant-level in-session scrollback differs from moderator transcript or browsing previous games; not duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Specific UI ordering requirement is unique and not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Semantically equivalent to PP-034 ('change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown') with the same actor and context, so this is a duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: UI personalization requirement is distinct and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Developer-level standards compliance is unique and not repeated.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Glossary/definitions requirement is unique and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Database indexing is a distinct developer requirement and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have the application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Browser compatibility targets are specific and not duplicated by other developer stories.

evaluations.evidence: have the site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is a distinct non-duplication requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance/response requirement is unique and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a distinct internationalization requirement and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design requirement is unique and not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error page UX requirement is distinct and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Data anonymization requirement for research differs from metrics or storage deletion stories; unique.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics visibility (requested by 'Mike') is distinct from anonymized research storage (PP-052); not a duplicate.
